scope: Read-only SHA-256 comparison of every payload byte for the exact 500 common tensor names in the current owner-authorized checkpoint pair. No tensor arrays or full model loaded.

tensor_name_set.canonicalization: SHA-256 over lexicographically sorted unique UTF-8 names joined by LF with one trailing LF

comparator.method: CPU-only bounded 1 MiB reads of Safetensors payload ranges; no model load or tensor arrays.
